error.RESULT_EXPIRED.zh-CN: 查询结果已过期，请重新运行。
error.RESULT_EXPIRED.en: The result has expired. Run the query again.

error.EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED.zh-CN: 实时更新游标已过期，请刷新页面。
error.EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED.en: The event cursor has expired. Refresh the page.

error.LLM_UNAVAILABLE.en: The model service is temporarily unavailable.

error.SESSION_BUSY.zh-CN: 当前会话正在处理请求，请等待本轮完成。
error.SESSION_BUSY.en: This session is busy. Wait for the current turn to finish.

error.CONTEXT_VERSION_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 会话范围已更新，请刷新后重试。
error.CONTEXT_VERSION_CONFLICT.en: The session scope has changed. Refresh and try again.

error.SKILL_TOO_LARGE.en: The skill package exceeds the size limit.

error.SKILL_INVALID.zh-CN: 技能包校验失败，请检查格式。
error.SKILL_INVALID.en: Skill validation failed. Check the package format.

error.SKILL_UNSUPPORTED.en: This skill package is not supported.

error.EXECUTION_ERROR.zh-CN: 查询执行失败，请查看原始错误。
error.EXECUTION_ERROR.en: Query execution failed. See the original error.

error.INVALID_SCOPE.zh-CN: 分析范围无效，请检查指标、期间和筛选条件。
error.INVALID_SCOPE.en: The analysis scope is invalid. Check the metric, periods and filters.

error.QUEUE_TIMEOUT.en: The query timed out in the queue.

error.QUERY_LOST.zh-CN: 查询执行状态丢失，请重新运行。
error.QUERY_LOST.en: The query was lost. Run it again.

error.RESULT_TRUNCATED.en: The result was truncated at the configured limit.

error.ANALYSIS_EXECUTION_ERROR.zh-CN: 分析执行失败，请查看原始错误。
error.ANALYSIS_EXECUTION_ERROR.en: Analysis execution failed. See the original error.
